config.title: Configuration
config.subtitle: LLM provider keys and local endpoints (Ollama / custom).
config.apiKeysHelp: Machine keys for automations (CI/CD, MCP, A2A) to call the Argus API with the X-API-Key header.
config.apiKeyShownOnce: Copy it now — this key won't be shown again.
config.retentionDaysHelp: Runs older than this are permanently deleted (artifacts + history). 0 disables pruning.

newRun.title: New Run
newRun.subtitle: Configure the target and the BDD script Argus will execute.
newRun.modeExecuteHelp: Runs a BDD script you already wrote.
newRun.modeExploreHelp: No script — Argus navigates on its own, discovers flows, and generates a candidate Gherkin script at the end for you to review. Only use against test/staging environments.
newRun.maxActionsHelp: Maximum number of actions the agent can take before ending the exploration (between 1 and 100).
newRun.confirmNonProduction: I confirm this is NOT a production environment — Argus will navigate and act on its own, with no step to follow.
newRun.confirmNonProductionRequired: Confirm the target isn't production before exploring.
newRun.binaryAuthSecretPlaceholder: optional — the configured secret's name, not its value
newRun.aabNotSupported: .aab isn't installable directly yet (no bundletool support) — export a universal .apk ("bundletool build-apks --mode=universal", or build one directly from Android Studio/Gradle) and upload that instead.
newRun.invalidJson: Test data is not valid JSON.
newRun.testDataMustBeObject: Test data must be a JSON object (key: value).

runsList.subtitle: Runs created, live or already finished.
runsList.title: {{count}} runs

runDetail.title: Run
runDetail.noScenariosYet: No scenarios yet — the run is being processed.
runDetail.generatedScriptHelp: Candidate generated automatically from the exploration — review before using it as a regression run.
runDetail.exploring: Exploring... the script shows up here once the exploration finishes.
